definitions.explanation: The act of appearing or coming into existence. Used for phenomena, creatures, people, or things that appear on the scene, often with a sense of something notable or unexpected.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{技術|ぎじゅつ}が{出現|しゅつげん}した。
{珍|めずら}しい{鳥|とり}がこの{地域|ちいき}に{出現|しゅつげん}した。
examples.english: A rare bird appeared in this area.

examples.japanese: インターネットの{出現|しゅつげん}により、{情報|じょうほう}の{伝|つた}わり{方|かた}が{大|おお}きく{変|か}わった。
examples.english: With the emergence of the internet, the way information spreads changed dramatically.

notes:
Often used in written or formal contexts to describe the arrival of something significant. As a する verb, it takes the form {出現|しゅつげん}する.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{突然|とつぜん}{出現|しゅつげん}する (appear suddenly)
・{出現|しゅつげん}{頻度|ひんど} (frequency of appearance)
・{新種|しんしゅ}の{出現|しゅつげん} (emergence of a new species)
・{出現|しゅつげん}{率|りつ} (appearance rate)
